authority.sample_work: Author authorises assigned on-workstation agent to develop and experiment locally with designated sample; keep patient-level processing local and raw records out of Git/chat exports; obey applicable platform constraints.
authority.production: Validate exact pipeline and freeze unresolved scientific decisions before author-reviewed full-run launch.
authority.private_drafts: May not exist in this checkout; no SAS runtime validation claimed.

primary.estimand: Same-fit fixed-effect trajectory prediction difference at a documented reference profile.
primary.uncertainty: Same-fit contrast covariance, DF, CI and estimability required.

approved_decisions.prior_units: Strictly earlier physical RBC unit starts in same ICU admission; exclude index-time ties; require complete unit ledger.
approved_decisions.parity: Female donors only for new parity fits; missing/unknown is not zero.
approved_decisions.table1: Each verified person once at first eligible event; resolve ties/conflicts.
approved_decisions.first_event_sensitivity: First eligible event per verified person.
approved_decisions.no_later_sensitivity: No additional unit starts in (index,index+720min]; complete patient-level follow-up, potentially beyond ICU admission.
approved_decisions.factor_inference: Endpoint-change heterogeneity plus all pairwise change differences; Holm within factor/outcome family for primary FULL inference.
approved_decisions.all_fits: Both adjustment sets, all seven outcomes, main plus five factors, all three populations.

three_time_scopes.index_eligibility: Previous patient-level transfusion history; explicitly resolve exact minus12h boundary.
three_time_scopes.count_covariate: Strictly earlier units in same ICU admission.
three_time_scopes.no_later_sensitivity: Patient-level future history in (0,+12h], with complete ascertainment; no observed later unit is not proof of full follow-up.

unresolved_decisions: Physical-unit identity, duplicates and simultaneous exposure
Observed windows, weighting and person-aware inference
Sparse-category eligibility and institutional disclosure policy
New clinical extraction or extra model structure

source_snapshot.meaning: Schema only; no source values, identity semantics, uniqueness, coverage or cohort provenance certified.

input_members.paths: Private workstation configuration only; public placeholders.

model_notes.recipient_profile: male, outcome-specific modal ward, long-row means; verify exact source
model_notes.base: time/age/ICU-time splines, sex, ward, prior-RBC covariate correction
model_notes.factors: time main effect plus factor main effect plus interaction
model_notes.settings: Freeze actual estimation and denominator-DF settings; do not assume remembered defaults.

public_forbidden: Private configuration and true machine paths
Development sample artifacts presented as production
acceptance: Synthetic boundary,missing,key,tie,episode and covariance tests pass in installed SAS
Exact sample pipeline completes and covers all code paths
Source mapping,coverage and scientific decisions documented
Required jobs and artifacts carry explicit validated status
Predictions and same-fit changes/pairwise contrasts reconcile
Covariance and DF match fit/design/profile identity
No independent-SE or shifted-level intervals used for changes
Public columns,content and disclosure screening complete
Dashboard,figure,tables use one approved full-cohort release
Joint cross-category covariance reproduces direct SAS differences-in-change SEs, including intended later time contrasts.

manuscript.author: Lucas D. Ekström
manuscript.fallback: Manual change instructions if tracked editing cannot be verified.

validation_status: Contract describes approved scope/requirements; does not validate implementation, unresolved science or SAS runtime.
unit_validation: Verify actual source scales, especially FiO2/SpO2 fraction versus percent. Intended display units are not proof of source scale; document conversions and transform uncertainty consistently.
archive_requirement: Retain JOINT fixed-effect/profile covariance across factor categories. Anchor reconstruction must include cross-category anchor-pair contrasts or equivalent verified joint covariance; disconnected within-category blocks are insufficient.
